paper: Alpha-GPT 2.0: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Quantitative Investment
headline_mechanism: Alpha-GPT 2.0 links human-guided Alpha Mining, Alpha Modeling, and Alpha Analysis agents in an iterative research cycle that generates factors, combines them into predictive models, and filters portfolio risks.

source_anchors.claim: Human insight guides automated experiments and experiment feedback guides the next research direction.
The mining agent translates ideas into formula factors and can deploy a 20-round GP search using mean-reversion seeds and Sharpe fitness.
The modeling agent combines alpha factors with model training, feature selection, benchmarking, and portfolio generation.
The analysis agent screens fundamental/event risk and can reduce weights of high-risk holdings.

preserved_elements: one explicit human research instruction fixed before evaluation
symbolic search from mean-reversion seed factors
past-only Sharpe-like factor fitness and top-five feature selection
a separate predictive modeling stage combining selected factors
a distinct fundamental and market-risk analysis stage
monthly feedback and re-estimation across the three-stage pipeline
approximated_elements: a deterministic arithmetic grammar replaces the unspecified Alpha Mining LLM/GP service
rolling rank-correlation information ratios replace the unspecified mining fitness implementation
rolling ridge regression replaces the model zoo and human model comparison
JKP volatility, distress, and quality characteristics replace news and knowledge-graph risk analysis
a fixed half-strength risk adjustment replaces natural-language blacklist and reweighting instructions
invented_elements: the six mean-reversion JKP seed identities
the exact identity, mean, difference, and product expression grammar
60-month training window and top-five selection rule
ridge penalty and 20 percent high-risk threshold
common value-weighted long/short decile portfolio adapter
human_instruction: Search from six price-reversal alphas, synthesize the five strongest past-only signals with a stable linear model, and halve conviction for the riskiest 20 percent of stocks.
portfolio_adapter: The post-analysis modeled score is ranked within the frozen monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to common value-weighted long/short deciles with 10 bp one-way cost.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored Alpha-GPT 2.0-inspired three-stage research pipeline, not an implementation of the proposed agents, private tools, human interactions, knowledge graph, or any native paper result.
